title: SentinelCI trust report v1
description: What `sentinel verify` found about one image digest (A4, ADR-0010), written with `--report-json`: every check of the trust report, in its fixed order, and the verdict. It records a verification made where the release key's public key was; the platform shows it, and Kyverno re-verifies at admission (A5): carrying a report adds no trust.

image.description: The image verified, by digest (the name is where it was read from, informational).

mode.description: `registry`: the image's signature and attestations read from its registry (what Kyverno reads). `evidence`: the Sigstore bundles of the evidence directory, offline.

repo.description: The repository the release had to come from (`--repo`).

builder_id.description: The builder the provenance had to name (`--builder-id`).

decision_id.description: The decision the verified decision attestation holds (Decision v1 `decision_id`), or null when no valid decision attestation was found. A trusted report always names one, and a release records a report only next to the decision it names (review of #86: a report of another release of the same digest is not this decision's).

key_sha256.description: sha256 of the public key every attestation had to be signed by (its DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo, as in the PEM file): which key was trusted.

verified_at.description: When the verification ran (UTC). A report is a statement about that moment.

trusted.description: True exactly when every check passed (checked by the producer and the platform; JSON Schema cannot).

detail.description: One line, as the trust report prints it (at most 300 characters).
